text_block_list.text:
A secret strategy for the Japanese Derby, made specifically to face Duramente.
—I review it one last time with Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's sort out your plan
for in case I don't draw the outermost bracket.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So, hypothetically, if Duramente-san runs 2,414m and I run 2,403m, I'd effectively get an 11m lead... right?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: P-Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Derby is a 2,400m turf race.
There's no way it would have an odd fractional number... right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Dia made me realize something. Even in the same race, the effective distance run differs for each Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume running on the outermost lane versus one on the inside...
...Their running distances are completely different, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: Right, this is about "cornering."
Yep, this is about "cornering."

text_block_list.text:
—Let's review.
A racetrack is oval in shape.

"Satono Crown ran hugging the inside corner, while Satono Diamond ran on the outside.
At that time, which of them will end up running more distance?"
choice_data_list: The answer is, of course, the outer diamond

text_block_list.text:
To prevent this "cornering loss,"
Umamusume battle for position
along the inner rail during a race.
Indeed, if you run a lap around Tokyo Racecourse, where the Derby is held, about 3 meters out from the inner rail—

Compared to the girl on the innermost rail,
it seems that Umamusume would end up running
about 19 meters further.
choice_data_list: In terms of lengths, that's about seven lengths

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Assuming everything goes smoothly, that is.
Gate positions included.
choice_data_list: With a gap like that, you've got this in the bag.
With a gap like that, you've got this in the bag.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
B-But still!
...It's not that simple, is it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You mentioned the other day, Trainer, that there are advantages to running on the outside.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...That merit must also be connected to the demerit of running along the inner rail."
choice_data_list: That's true.

text_block_list.text: Competition along the inner rail is especially fierce, and with pressure from other Umamusume, the situation changes rapidly.

If you handle it well, you'll gain an advantage in distance, but...
For an Umamusume who wants to run at her own pace,
it puts quite a heavy strain on her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So, girls who don't want to get boxed in at the crucial moment or who want to focus on their own running choose the outside.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
However, the drawbacks of hugging the inner rail
don't apply to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Because I have the calm mind and broad vision
needed to adjust my positioning
to suit any situation."
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's right.
Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.text: She had always been level-headed, but reflecting on how she let nerves get the better of her at the Tokyo Sports Hai, she honed that strength of hers even further.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Moreover, she has the mental fortitude to withstand the pressure of other Umamusume and patiently push forward along the inner rail.
choice_data_list: Ah, this is your specialty, huh
Yeah, this is right up your alley.

text_block_list.text:
No matter how much pressure bears down on her,
she can smile and see it as an opportunity.
That's the kind of girl I've seen her be.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Well, even someone like me has one real challenge to deal with, though.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: With this strategy, we absolutely cannot afford to be overly conscious of Duramente-san. Isn't that right?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.
...Yeah.

text_block_list.text: In short, this strategy boils down to: "No matter who's there, stick to what you do best."
...This is unexpectedly difficult.

The reason I hadn't thought of this plan in the first place
was because I had been obsessively conscious of Duramente
ever since the Satsuki Sho.

"How to out-surge Duramente."
"How to contain Duramente's legs."
"Can we drag Duramente into an unfavorable race development?"
choice_data_list: That's just how shocking Duramente was.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Her presence is simply overwhelming.
If you watch her run even once,
your attention is completely stolen away."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's why everyone gets anxious.
Thinking that in the Derby, they have to adapt their running
and change themselves to match hers...
choice_data_list: Honestly, a lot of Uma Musume end up like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I know. I've seen girls end up like that,
and we were the same way once too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...However, I will be the first to break out of this spiral.
choice_data_list: Ah, you can do it
Yeah, you can do it.

text_block_list.text:
"...If my trainee hadn't been
Satono Crown, I might not have even
suggested this strategy."
This strategy demands audacious mental fortitude, sharp judgment to read the flow of the race, and a generational top-class final kick.

"Besides, that comes with the added condition of
her gaining absolute confidence in herself
by honing that ability."
choice_data_list: (The only girl I know like that is Satono Crown.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
OK!
Well, let's not waste any time, so...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: “—Dia. We can borrow your uncle's helicopter, right?”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
! Yes,
it looks like they just arrived.
(Clatter clatter clatter clatter clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks!
Alright, hop on. You too, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Your family bought another
new island, didn't they, Kura-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It hasn't been properly maintained yet, but...
it's perfect for this special training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...If I'm only inviting my own collaborator,
I'd feel bad using the academy's track, after all."

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Crown! Oh my gosh, it's been
forever! You're so tall now!

text_block_list.name: Crown's Instructor
text_block_list.text:
"小姐、又到訓練嘅時候了嗎？
(Milady, is it time for training?)"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Thanks for making the time!
(Thank you for coming even though you're busy!)
choice_data_list: Umm, who are these people...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let me introduce you.
This is my friend from Hong Kong, and...
this is the teacher who taught me how to run!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Come, Trainer.
There are Umamusume here who will put pressure on me
without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Even if, regrettably, our previous plan can no longer be used—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If I rack up plenty of real race experience,
I'll be able to upgrade the weapons in my arsenal, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Heh—

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Crown? 妳連點玩追都唔記得嗱？
(Did you forget how to play tag?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"NO!!
Enjoy being carefree while you still can!"

And Satono Crown is forged through tough competition
alongside her fellow Umamusume.

Composure and a wide field of vision
to position oneself according to the situation.

The mental fortitude to endure without yielding
to the pressure of the other Umamusume.

"Furthermore, the adaptability to maintain strong footing
and adjust instantly, even in an environment
different from the Academy's turf."
choice_data_list: (And by honing that weapon, it fosters—)

text_block_list.text: "A limitless confidence in her own running will be the key to defeating Duramente."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Kura-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Crown! You're racing me next!

Satono Crown runs on her private training track
alongside the many Umamusume who rushed from Hong Kong to help her.

"...Still, it's impressive how everything came together.
Right before the Derby, securing running partners and a venue is usually so difficult."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ! Fufu. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Satono will spare no effort in supporting you.
We promise our full backing... understood?
choice_data_list: ...Ah, it really was just as I was told.
...Yeah, it was just like they said.

text_block_list.text:
Though little time remained,
Satono Crown's preparations to defeat Duramente
steadily began falling into place.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Man, it's already been a month since the Satsuki Sho! The Japanese Derby is right around the corner... How are you feeling, Duramente?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The adjustments went without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Needless to say,
everything is proceeding without issue.
I will display performance that lives up to expectations."

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: R-Right, exactly!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The whirlwind stirred up by Duramente-san is truly sensational!
We've also received this comment from one of our viewers!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"Though many Umamusume are hailed as 'the strongest',
this year simply cannot be discussed without you!"
Man, what an ecstatic comment, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —You can't talk about it without mentioning me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How gratifying.
It seems some have acknowledged you as one of the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I won't settle for just a small corner.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Dura?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest means the 'most' 'powerful.'
Not merely one of the elite, but the sole supreme ruler."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Please tell the person who sent that message this:
Just as you said, I must not become conceited yet.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest must never be perceived
as someone who can be surpassed."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: In that case, next—until I receive their complete surrender.
